Formula localHistogram[getBin(outValue)] += 1 (atomic) for every live node, where outValue is its live out-degree and getBin(d) = min(floor(d / binWidth), BIN_COUNT - 1) for the linear rule (the last bin saturates; log2 binning uses bin 0 for d = 0, else min(1 + floor(log2 d), BIN_COUNT - 1)). Each workgroup then adds its non-empty bins to the summary words, so integer addition makes the histogram independent of thread order. The in-degree and total-degree histograms use the same rule.
